name: v75_equity_method_income_yield
hypothesis: Higher income from equity-method investments relative to assets may identify companies with valuable unconsolidated affiliates and partnership earnings that are not captured by ordinary operating-income yields.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(equity_method_investment_income / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(equity_method_investment_income_total / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Ultra-low-use equity-method income fields; avoids ordinary operating-income/FCF anchors.

name: v75_equity_method_low_complexity
hypothesis: Lower equity-method investment balance with positive affiliate income may proxy cleaner corporate structure and capital efficiency.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * investments_equity_method_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(equity_method_investment_income / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * equity_method_investment_total / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 126), industry)
notes: Tests capital-light affiliate structure rather than simple affiliate-income strength.

name: v75_equity_method_ownership_focus
hypothesis: Lower ownership concentration in equity-method investments may reduce opacity and governance leakage while preserving affiliate income signal.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(equity_investment_ownership_percent), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(equity_investment_ownership_ratio), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(equity_method_investment_income / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Uses ownership-percent fields as a disclosure/opacity axis, not a standard profitability ratio.

name: v75_equity_method_income_growth
hypothesis: Improving equity-method income may capture affiliate earnings momentum before it appears in consolidated fundamentals.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(equity_method_investment_income / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(equity_method_investment_income / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * investments_equity_method_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Growth-oriented equity-method income test; reject if turnover rises without Sharpe.
